summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 10.5.0: the SOCKS proxy and iDRAC8 share limits, idrac_storage_volume falsely reporting success on BOSS-N1 when a virtual disk exists, idrac_support_assist failing with NFS subdirectories, ome_diagnostics SupportAssist export failing on OME 4.0.0, and same-named uplinks being modified.
questions: Why does idrac_storage_volume report success on a BOSS-N1 controller when nothing was created?
Why does idrac_support_assist fail with my NFS share path?
Does ome_diagnostics export SupportAssist logs on OME 4.0.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (10.5.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no export via SOCKS proxy to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `idrac_firmware`: no authenticated HTTP/HTTPS/FTP shares on iDRAC8.
- `idrac_storage_volume`: reports success instead of failure on BOSS-N1 if a virtual disk already exists.
- `idrac_support_assist`: fails when the NFS share path has a subdirectory.
- `ome_diagnostics`: SupportAssist log export fails on OME 4.0.0.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
